ov: A hairless, pink-skinned burrowing rodent of the Horn of Africa and Kenya. It lives in colonies with a single breeding queen and is almost cold-blooded. It barely feels some kinds of pain, resists cancer, and lives longer than any other rodent.
rg: The Horn of Africa and parts of Kenya.
df: Underground tubers; workers that find a new one call the colony to it.
fx: Naked mole-rats can live more than 37 years, and their risk of dying does not rise with age.
It can run backwards as fast as forwards through its tunnels.
notes: The animals.js fact is confirmed: mortality does not rise with age, high cancer resistance, and 18 minutes with no oxygen.
